prompt: On a sunny beach, golden sand stretches into the distance, with five colorful beach umbrellas standing side by side near the shoreline. Under one umbrella, a striped beach towel lies flat beside a straw hat, a pair of sunglasses, and a half-open book. A blue beach ball rolls gently beside a red sand bucket, and a green shovel rests against a wooden lifeguard chair. In the water, two sailboats glide on the horizon while three seagulls soar overhead. A coconut drink with a straw sits next to a picnic basket filled with sandwiches and a bottle of lemonade. A volleyball net stands between two tall palm trees, and a seashell collection is laid out on a driftwood log. Nearby, a painted wooden sign points toward the pier as a flock of sandpipers scuttles at the water’s edge. A frisbee lies abandoned on the sand, and a glass jar of seashells sits half-buried. Close by, a brightly colored surfboard stands upright beside a snorkel mask lying on the sand. There is no sandcastle, no polka dot towel, no discarded plastic bottle, no metal cooler, and no barbecue grill.
